3. One Hajee Abdul Majid filed Other Class Suit No. 113 of 1995 against the Deputy Commissioner, Mymensingh and some other persons for declaration of title and confirmation of possession in 2.85 acres of land out of total 35.35 acres of land of C.S. Plot. No.102 of C.S. Khatian Nos. 3, 13, 14 and 15 of mouza Rabirmara, Fulpur, District-Mymensingh. The case of this plaintiff, in short, was that this land originally belonged to Charu Chandra, Gopal Dhar Chowdhury, Raja Shashi Kanta Acharjee, Satindra Kumar Chowdhury and others. That since the Plaintiff had his own land in plot Nos. 37, 39 and 41 to the contiguous north of this suit land of plot No.102 the plaintiff, since his predecessors' time, had been possessing the suit land for more than 90 years. That though the plaintiff thus acquired good title in this suit land by virtue of adverse possession the suit land was wrongly recorded in the khas khatian of the government and taking advantage of this wrong recording of the suit land the defendant No. 12 and many others took settlement of the suit land from the government illegally. 

 4. The defendants, in different sets contested that suit. Their material case was that the suit land, admittedly, was the khas land of the original Jamindars and as such, after acquisition of Jamindars, the suit land vested in the government and as such has been rightly recorded in the khas khatian of the government. That the plaintiff has no right, title and possession in the suit land. That the suit land has been rightly and legally, leased out to different persons by the government.
